recommended_rendering.note: Using the same 384x512 frame draw size as Shion keeps Shiopon visibly smaller because the character occupies less of the cell.

notes: All sheets use true transparent alpha.
Every frame uses the same 384x512 cell as Shion.
Feet/bottom contact is aligned to baseline_y=480.
Tiny isolated generation speckles were removed without regenerating the character.
This pack was split from the approved Shiopon sprite sheet and is ready for GitHub game integration.
